informal_statement: The component four-arc perimeter equals the canonical complete-frontier perimeter.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At FrontierPerimeter.lean:1794-1844, the source contract is `theorem fourArc_frontier_weightedPerimeter_eq (lam : ℝ) (assembly : FourArcAssembly) : assembly.weightedPerimeter lam = WeightedPerimeter lam (FrontierMeasure assembly.carrier)`. The length measure is Euclidean one-dimensional Hausdorff measure on the complete frontier. Arc/segment unions are combined using their proved null overlaps; glued internal chords are not charged as exterior boundary.
